processNotes: All tooling, processes, routing, and times are inferred demo estimates.
No historical routing was supplied. The work-center order is inferred; manufactured components are assumed to arrive formed and ready for the demonstrated operations.
The frame geometry and component placement shown are illustrative, not confirmed dimensions or joining specifications. No heat-treatment process is specified for the representative product.
The supplied BOM does not identify fork-retention hardware, so the fork is checked without claiming a completed retained installation.
variantNotes: The representative is silver, size 42. Silver variants are available in sizes 40, 42, 44, 48, and 52; their supplied direct BOMs use 8 OZ of Paint - Silver, product 494.
Black variants are available in sizes 40, 42, 44, 48, and 52. Their supplied direct BOMs substitute 8 OZ of Paint - Black, product 492, for the representative's silver paint.

All supplied variants list the same other direct component IDs and quantities. The snapshot does not specify size-dependent geometry or additional component substitutions; do not assume one size is interchangeable with another.

revisions.description: Initial controlled issue for product introduction; established the component list and work-center sequence.
Aligned component count checks with the bill of materials and removed a duplicate sign-off box.
Clarified identification of Top Tube; retained the source part number in the point-of-use checklist.

Released the illustrated workstation edition: Illustrative frame arrangement and fork fit check. Matched numbered component legends to the operating steps and adopted the Manufacturing Hub document layout.

100081.title: Illustrative frame arrangement and fork fit check
guidance: Position 1 EA of Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301), 1 EA of Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828), 1 EA of Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377), and 1 EA of Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019) in an assumed frame jig. See the illustrative arrangement in 100081.
Position 4 EA of Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985) and 2 EA of Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812) at the rear of the frame in the assumed jig arrangement.
Present 1 EA of LL Fork (Product Number FK-1639) beneath the head tube for a non-retained fit check, as in 100081. Do not infer retention hardware or a completed fork installation.
